region: Penn Yan · Seneca Lake, Finger Lakes, New York
about: Anthony Road Wine Company sits on the west side of Seneca Lake, between Geneva and Dresden. Ann and John Martini settled the land in 1973, planted their first few acres of vines, and in 1990 opened a winery in a converted farm shop. Today the second generation runs the business, and Peter Becraft, who joined in 2006, has been head winemaker since 2014. The estate covers about 100 acres overlooking the lake, and its tasting room doubles as a gallery for local artists.

The vineyards grow on limestone-rich Honeoye soils, with the deep lake moderating both the winter cold and the summer heat. Its rosé is made from Cabernet Franc grown in two vineyards on the southwest side of Seneca Lake. The grapes are picked alongside the red-wine fruit and pressed straight away, with little skin contact, so the wine takes only a light colour, and it is made dry, unoaked and bottled under screwcap. As rosé, Cabernet Franc keeps its red fruit and herbal lift; Expect cherry, watermelon, nectarine, flowers and herbs.
facts: Two sites on the southwest side of Seneca Lake
